from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users

def test_search_users():
    # Valid search
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": "ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada"

    # Case insensitive
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": "ADA"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    
    # Substring
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": "example"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 2
    
    # Invalid query (missing)
    status, result = handle_search_users({})
    assert status == 400
    assert result["error"] == "invalid query"
    
    # Invalid query (blank)
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": "  "})
    assert status == 400
    assert result["error"] == "invalid query"
    
    # Invalid query (not string)
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": 123})
    assert status == 400
    assert result["error"] == "invalid query"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_search_users()
    print("Tests passed!")
